provenance.authoring_note: Bounded morphology and candidate existence come from the approved local source/index evidence. Each admitted gloss and disposition is Typewriter-authored. Diagnostic sentence frames are authored examples, not corpus excerpts or measured writer outcomes. Unresolved candidates remain held; no relation or admission is generated automatically.

review.method: Separately verify each candidate-level admit against the exact corpus-derived morphology/evidence and Typewriter canonical surface coverage; author a concise lexical gloss; review one-sense boundaries in two Typewriter-authored diagnostic frames; then apply the common semantic admission contract. Corpus counts prioritize the bounded queue only.
criteria: exact source-bound candidate identity, observed morpheme and proposed POS
no canonical lemma, curated search-form or generated-surface collision
unambiguous observed morphology and a bounded in-scope lexical meaning
separate Typewriter-authored gloss and writer route judgment
single-sense boundary review with exact gloss binding
zero relations when no candidate-specific relation is separately supported
no admission by corpus frequency or unmeasured writer usefulness

coverage_basis: source-bound Typewriter lexical axis after semantic eligibility
selection.selection_rationale: The semantic import count is derived from the complete separately authored candidate review: only rows marked admit enter this semantic pool, and all nine semantic decisions are included after shared eligibility. The corpus priority order and 20-row review limit are not admission quotas.
